tasks.task: Write a weekly batch of Pins ready to make and schedule

items.when: Once a week, to run the batch in one sitting with the steps and checks in order
When the board map exists and you need 30 Pins with titles, descriptions and image ideas
When the Pin titles all sound alike, to get several different angles for the same page
Before scheduling, to check each Pin's promise is kept by the page it links to

tasks.task: Build a Pinterest keyword list and board map

items.when: When starting or rebuilding an account, to get up to 12 boards named as real searches
When boards are named after moods or product lines and need renaming as search phrases
Before the board map, to sort a raw phrase list by what the searcher wants and group it
When you need the questions shoppers ask around a product, to widen the phrase list
When the list is built from product names, to start again from the buyer's questions

tasks.task: Plan a 90-day seasonal Pin calendar

items.when: When you need publish-by dates set ahead of each seasonal climb for the next 90 days
When you have looked up phrases in Pinterest Trends and need the climb and peak weeks read
When you want to see what is rising for the topic on other platforms before it reaches Pins
When the shop has sales data, to pick which products each seasonal moment should push

tasks.task: Write the quarterly Pinterest plan

items.when: About three weeks before each quarter, to turn the review, keywords and seasons into one plan
Before the plan, to see what content works for rival accounts and where the gaps are
When the client has no topic plan and Pins need subjects drawn from customer words
When nobody has asked whether the client's buyers are on Pinterest at all

tasks.task: Review a Pinterest Analytics export and say what to change

items.when: When you have the export and need top and weak Pins and boards and what winners share
Each quarter, or when Pinterest traffic goes flat, for a quick read of one export
When you need orders and revenue by source to check clicks from Pins turned into sales
When you compare Pin formats, to see which earned their place and which to stop

tasks.task: Turn one product, recipe or post into several fresh Pins

items.when: When one page deserves more than one Pin and each must look and read differently
When the product seems plain, to get eight angles that each make a different Pin
Each month, to pick last month's best pieces and turn them into new Pins
When several Pins point at one page, to check each one still matches what the page says

tasks.task: Design Pin images, text overlays and reusable templates

items.when: Before making images, to set the visual choices and lock the ones that must stay
When you need three or four layouts with text zones and product placement to compare
When every Pin looks like the same template, to get three hand-made alternatives
When a Pin needs a new picture and you want a prompt, the exact size and a file plan
When the client's team will make and reuse the Pin templates themselves
When a Pin is drafted, to see where the eye lands first and what to cut from the overlay
When the image is crowded with badges and text and needs stripping to one clear thing

tasks.task: Plan product and lifestyle photos for Pins

items.when: When the shop's photos do not match each other, to get a style sheet and nine prompts
When a photographer will shoot for Pins and needs a shot list with a reason per shot
When there is only one product photo, to get a set of new angles and scenes to choose from
When AI images show people, to check for stereotypes, cloned faces and odd hands

tasks.task: Plan and script video Pins

items.when: Before filming, to pick a format that fits the product and who can be on camera
When the first two seconds are weak, to get ten opening lines to choose from
When there is no footage, to turn a main product photo into a short moving clip
Before publishing, to score each opening line and get a rewrite of the weak ones

tasks.task: Make step-by-step, list and infographic Pins

items.when: Before drawing, to plan which picture pairs with each step so the point sticks
When a how-to or checklist should become one tall image with a layout that fits it
When the idea needs several cards, to plan each card's picture and words in order
When the infographic looks like a stock template, to get three other layouts
When the tall image is drafted, to trace the eye path and cut what slows the reader

tasks.task: Set up the shop catalogue and product Pins

items.when: When a shop wants its products on Pinterest or its conversions do not match its sales
When feed titles are bare product names and need the phrases shoppers search for
When product titles are messy or uneven and the feed needs one tidy pattern
Before the feed is submitted, to find images to resize or rename and missing alt text

tasks.task: Plan and budget a Pinterest ad campaign

items.when: When the client wants shopping ads, to get tag, catalogue and campaign steps in order
Before any spend, to work out the return and cost per order the margin can bear
When the budget is small, to stage the test so images run before video
When you promote Pins, to plan clearly different versions and when to refresh them
When the plan is a big launch on a guess, to shrink it to one small test with a clear offer

tasks.task: Read Pinterest ad results and decide what to keep or cut

items.when: When results are in by ad group, to get keep, leave or replace calls and false winners
When Pinterest reports a high return, to test it against the shop's own totals
When buyers answer how they found the shop, to see if Pinterest is over or under-credited

tasks.task: Check Pins and ads against policy before they go live

items.when: Before an ad, or a Pin with a discount, strong claim, paid or affiliate content, goes live
When the ad and its page both need a line-by-line risk check with safer rewrites
When you have the approved facts, to find issues in the ad and what a person must confirm

tasks.task: Set up the Pinterest tag, tagged links and conversion tracking

items.when: When Pin links carry no tags, to get one naming pattern and tagged links per campaign
When sales from Pins are missing or doubled and the tracking needs repair
Each month, to catch tracking that broke after a theme or checkout change

tasks.task: Check the pages Pins send people to

items.when: When a Pin gets clicks but no sales, to score how well the page matches the Pin
When the page itself is the weak point, to rank its problems by effect on sales
When saved links show the wrong title or image, to fix the page tags Pins read from

tasks.task: Plan blog posts and guides that feed Pinterest

items.when: When a shop has few pages worth pinning, to plan 10 to 30 posts that lift its collections
When a blog has no topic groups, to plan clusters that each become a board
When the blog has years of old posts, to pick which to update before making fresh Pins
When a post has no image worth pinning and needs a cover that fits the piece

tasks.task: Audit the account set-up, profile and boards

items.when: When you suspect set-up gaps such as an unclaimed site, no Rich Pins or a broken tag
When the audit finds boards nobody would search for and they need new names
When the profile and recent Pins need scoring against the brand's own rules
When Pins saved from the site pull the wrong title, price or picture

tasks.task: Find out who the pinners are and what they plan

items.when: When you have reviews and buyer stories, to get avatar cards built on a job and a trigger
When you want what people ask and want, in their own words, from social comments
When the product page and reviews hold the best phrases, to sort them for titles
When the buyer picture is a guess, to check where these people really spend attention

tasks.task: Set a consistent look for the account's Pins

items.when: When the look is undecided, to compare three mood board directions and pick one
When the look is chosen, to write firm colour, type and grid rules every Pin follows
When the feed is tidy but nothing in it would stop a thumb

tasks.task: Plan creator, gifting and affiliate Pins

items.when: When the brand wants creators pinning its products, to plan deals, briefs and tracking
When products are sent as gifts, to plan the box card and track which posts follow
Before a paid or affiliate Pin is published, to check it is labelled and allowed

tasks.task: Write the monthly Pinterest report for the client

items.when: When the month's export is in and you need the main findings before writing
When the client needs trends, wins, misses and what changes next in one report
When the report must show orders and revenue from Pins, not only saves and clicks

always.when: Before any work that must match the client's live site: colours, fonts and voice
At the start of a new client, to put product facts in one file every later step reads
When a Pin states a number, a result or a claim you cannot trace to the client
Before a batch is scheduled, to catch typos and product names spelt two ways

helpers.when: When the job needs finished Pin templates or image files, not only image ideas
When the shop's photos are too few or too plain to make fresh Pins from
When there are not enough posts or guides worth pinning and they must be written
When the catalogue feed, the tag or the checkout events need fixing inside the store
When the client asks what Pinterest really adds on top of search, email and other ads
When video Pins need cutting, captions and exports from real footage

gaps: No library item is about Pinterest itself: Pin titles, boards, Pinterest search and Trends are covered only by the kit
No library item plans a Pinterest ad campaign: objectives, targeting, bids and structure. The ad planners cover Meta, Google and TikTok
No library item lays out a 2:3 Pin image with a text overlay or makes three Pin template directions to compare
No library item scores a finished Pin before it is scheduled: title, image readability on a phone, link and board fit
No library item covers the Pinterest catalogue feed, Rich Pins, claiming a site or checking the Pinterest tag step by step
No library item specs video Pins or multi-page Pins: length, cover frame, safe areas and what to say in the first seconds
No tool guide covers a Pin scheduler such as Tailwind or Pinterest's own scheduler
No library item plans Pins for a blogger who earns from ads and affiliate links rather than a shop
No library item reads Pinterest Trends data or sets seasonal publish dates outside the kit
